title: Go-CAD gold-gate audit, unverified issue leads, and peer-release freshness
mode: Primary-source research and local source/plan crosswalk; research-only
scope: Audit the publicly visible go-cad gold-comparison helpers for denominator and opt-in behavior without generalizing their behavior to the entire claimed strict-gate suite.
Separate go-cad issue #1's large-file DWG and zero-handle DXF reports from reproduced local defects.
Refresh ACadSharp formal release and open ACIS-related PR status, and distinguish LibreDWG NEWS release status from the current nightly artifact.
Translate the evidence into an optional, exact-profile peer checkpoint and concrete readiness checks without adding a test lane, dependency, fixture, or support claim.

sources.revision: Mutable main, README, and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-19; no immutable source commit or runtime artifact was pinned.
sources.observed: README self-reports 37 DWG drawings, 34 strict hard-gated, 62 value rows, 59/59 DXF cases, and a 147-file reliability corpus; it explicitly excludes ACIS kernel/geometry reconstruction. The reviewed optional gold helpers are environment-gated. TestGoldLineMatch excludes missing handles from its match/total success predicate, TestGoldAllEntitiesMatch skips missing/wrong-type handles before incrementing total, and TestGoldLayerColors excludes absent handles from total. The full claimed 62-gate suite was not audited. Open issue #1 alleges >=18 MB R2004-family failures and zero table handles in DXF output, but the reviewed body has no attached sample or reproducible trace; the reports are unverified and not libdxfrw findings.

sources.revision: Release and PR pages reviewed 2026-10-19; latest formal release v3.8.0 is signed at short commit 3a1c66b; PR #1150 and #1174 display Open.
sources.observed: v3.7.16 (Sep 18, 2026) includes the listed DXF reader/writer refactor; v3.8.0 (Sep 21, 2026) is listed latest and its release note lists InternalsVisibleTo. Open #1150 discussion identifies a schema-driven writer as desired rather than raw storage replay and reports a last-group-310 ACDSDATA readback issue after refactoring; these open-branch comments are not released capability or independent runtime evidence.

sources.revision: NEWS and releases page reviewed 2026-10-19; releases page top Windows nightly 0.14.8612 points to short commit f860b0f.
sources.observed: NEWS records version 0.14.1 dated 2026-07-25; the GitHub releases page currently leads with pre-release Windows nightly 0.14.8612 dated 2026-10-13. Treat the release and nightly as distinct artifacts.

localEvidence: tests/wave1_tests.cpp:1328-1354 — existing raw-DXF tests reject missing, zero, and duplicate self handles.
tests/wave1_tests.cpp:3943 — existing record inventory check rejects duplicate emitted handles.
src/libdxfrw.cpp — normal table-record allocation uses the local nonzero DXF handle allocator; route-wide writer qualification remains separate.

src/intern/dwgreader18.cpp:214-216, 304-308, 597, 896 — existing R2004+ system-page, section-capacity/logical-size, and page-map paths provide the local owner crosswalk if a large-file report is reproduced.
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md existing external evidence tiers, R2004+ page/section bounds, owner closure, and composed native/semantic gates.

assessment.planImpact: Adds optional-peer denominator qualification, unverified go-cad issue leads, and current release identity to the plan; improves implementation readiness without promoting capability or adding external prerequisites.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local source/plan audit
method.limitations: The go-cad README and main-branch source are mutable and were not pinned or executed. Only the reviewed gold helper source was audited, not all 62 claimed strict gates. Issue #1 is a reporter statement without a reproduced input in the reviewed body. Release/PR status is a point-in-time observation, not runtime qualification.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep go-cad optional and question-specific; pin exact source commit, toolchain, build flags, binary/package and input hashes before any comparator run.

Use an independently authored expected identity/value manifest and compare expected/observed unions; report missing, extra, wrong-type, skipped, unsupported, parse-error, and value-mismatch outcomes separately.
Do not treat the README's 62 strict rows as audited by this source review or use the opt-in gold helper's intersection percentage as full-presence coverage.

For any DXF writer qualification, strict-reopen emitted ASCII/Binary output independently as applicable and check nonzero unique handles plus owner/reference closure; existing raw-input handle tests do not qualify every output route.

Investigate go-cad issue #1 only if a local supported path reproduces it; capture the exact AC version, first failing stage, page/section geometry, and bounded trace, then use generated in-memory boundary controls and ODA-led reconciliation without importing peer thresholds/opcodes as facts.

Keep raw ACIS/AcDs carrier retention, owner association, independent parsing, native open/regeneration, and analytic B-rep semantics separate; go-cad's stated lack of a kernel cannot satisfy semantic evidence.

Keep ACadSharp v3.8.0 released behavior separate from open #1150/#1174 branches and LibreDWG 0.14.1 release evidence separate from 0.14.8612 nightly; no ordinary dependency, peer install, CI lane, or full-suite cadence change.
